description: One-page monthly back-office list for a Korean sole proprietor or small company: this month's filing deadlines (withholding tax, VAT, payment statements, income or corporate tax), 4 social insurance premiums (10th), monthly-total tax invoices (10th, 부가가치세법 제34조③), wage statements on payday (근로기준법 제48조②), and event deadlines for hires (written contract, insurance enrolment by the 15th of the next month) and leavers (settle wages and severance within 14 days, insurance loss report). Due dates move past weekends and public holidays; overdue items and deadlines that fall next month are separated; adds routine monthly bookkeeping. December fiscal year-end; no filing or drafting.
